camel_example: aliyun ga CreateBasicAccelerator --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key 'tag-key' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxshhcsn0000' --PromotionOptionNo 500032980140000 --PricingCycle Month --AutoRenew false --DryRun false --Duration 1 --AutoPay false --AutoRenewDuration 1 --BandwidthBillingType CDT --AutoUseCoupon false --ChargeType PREPAY --Tag.1.Value 'tag-value' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken 123e45670000
description_en: Creates a basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Basic GA instances rely on Alibaba Cloud's premium global Internet bandwidth and high-quality transmission networks to provide point-to-point acceleration. They are primarily used for Layer 3 (IP protocol) network acceleration. You can call the CreateBasicAccelerator operation to create a basic GA instance
description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例依托阿里云优质的全球互联网带宽与高品质传输网络，为用户提供点到点的加速体验。基础型全球加速实例主要用于三层（IP协议）网络加速。您可以通过调用CreateBasicAccelerator接口创建一个基础型全球加速实例
kebab_example: aliyun ga create-basic-accelerator --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e45670000 --duration 1 --pricing-cycle Month --bandwidth-billing-type CDT --auto-pay false --auto-use-coupon false --promotion-option-no 500032980140000 --auto-renew false --auto-renew-duration 1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxshhcsn0000 --charge-type PREPAY --dry-run false --tag Value=tag-value Key=tag-key --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBasicAccelerator

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the basic GA instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The purchase duration.

If PricingCycle is set to Month, valid values for Duration are 1 to 9.

If PricingCycle is set to Year, valid values for Duration are 1 to 3
parameters.help_zh:
购买时长。

当PricingCycle取值Month时，Duration取值范围为1~9。

当PricingCycle取值Year时，Duration取值范围为1~3
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle. Valid values:

Month: monthly billing.

Year: yearly billing
parameters.help_zh:
计费周期。取值：

Month：按月计费。

Year：按年计费
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth billing method. Valid values:
BandwidthPackage: billed by bandwidth plan.
CDT: billed by traffic and settled uniformly by Cloud Data Transfer (CDT).
CDT95: billed based on the 95th percentile bandwidth and settled uniformly by CDT. This bandwidth billing method is available only to whitelisted users
parameters.help_zh:
带宽计费方式。取值：
BandwidthPackage：按带宽包计费。
CDT：按流量计费并由云数据传输（Cloud DataTransfer，简称CDT）统一结算。
CDT95：按95计费并由CDT统一结算。该带宽计费方式仅白名单用户可用
parameters.name: bandwidth_billing_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

false (default): Automatic payment is disabled. After an order is generated, you must go to the Order Center to complete the payment.

true: Automatic payment is enabled and the order is automatically paid
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费，取值：

false（默认值）：不开启自动付费，生成订单后需要到订单中心完成支付。

true：开启自动付费，自动支付订单
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use coupons for automatic payment of bills. Valid values:

true: yes.

false (default): no.

This parameter takes effect only when AutoPay is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券自动支付账单。取值：

true：使用。

false（默认值）：不使用。

仅AutoPay为true时，该项才生效
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en:
The coupon code.
This parameter is applicable only to the international site
parameters.help_zh:
优惠券号码。
仅国际站涉及该参数
parameters.name: promotion_option_no

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: yes.

false (default): no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费。

true：是。

false（默认值）：否
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal duration. Unit: months.

Valid values: 1 to 12. Default value: 1.

This parameter takes effect only when AutoRenew is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费时长。单位：月。

取值范围：1~12。默认值：1。

仅AutoRenew的为true时，该项才生效
parameters.name: auto_renew_duration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the basic GA instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所属资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PREPAY (default): subscription.
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：
PREPAY（默认值）：代表预付费，即包年包月方式付费。
POSTPAY：代表后付费，即按使用时长方式付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run and does not create the resource. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false (default): performs a normal request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建资源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the basic GA instance. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot start with aliyun or acs:, or contain http:// or https://.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys
fields.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的标签键。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

您最多可输入20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the basic GA instance. The tag value cannot be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with aliyun or acs:, or contain http:// or https://.

You can specify up to 20 tag values
fields.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的标签值。一旦输入该值，不可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

您最多可输入20个标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the basic GA instance
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的标签
parameters.name: tag

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the basic GA instance

OrderId.description_en:
The order ID.

This parameter is returned when ChargeType is set to PREPAY.

If AutoPay is set to false, which means automatic payment is disabled, go to the <props="china">Order Center (https://usercenter2.aliyun.com/order/list)</props>
<props="intl">Order Center (https://usercenter2-intl.aliyun.com/order/list)</props> to complete the payment
OrderId.description_zh:
订单ID。

当ChargeType（付费类型）取值为 PREPAY（预付费）时，返回该参数。

如果AutoPay取值为false，即未开启自动支付账单时，请前往<props="china">订单中心 (https://usercenter2.aliyun.com/order/list)</props>
<props="intl">订单中心 (https://usercenter2-intl.aliyun.com/order/list)</props>完成支付
